src_sentence: Auf dieser Basis kommt eine von der Spielautomatenwirtschaft finanzierte und in Auftrag gegebene Analyse vom Forschungsinstitut für Glücksspiel und Wetten zum Schluss, dass obgleich es sich bei der Spielsucht um eine ernstzunehmende Krankheit handelt, die volkswirtschaftlichen Auswirkungen bei Heranziehen einer Kosten-Nutzen-Analyse weit unter jenen Wohlfahrtskosten liegen, welche durch Alkohol- und Tabakmissbrauch entstehen, durch die jährliche Sozialkosten von 40 Milliarden Euro entstünden.
translation: On this basis, an analysis financed and commissioned by the slot machine industry from the Research Institute for Gambling and Betting concludes that although gambling addiction is a serious illness, the macroeconomic impacts, when using a cost-benefit analysis, are far below the welfare costs caused by alcohol and tobacco abuse, which generate annual social costs of 40 billion euros.

src_sentence: Nach 1837 begann die große Zeit der Spielbanken von Baden-Baden, Bad Homburg und Wiesbaden, wo Fjodor Michailowitsch Dostojewski das Roulette kennenlernte und diesem Spiel verfiel – aus diesem Erlebnis entstand der Roman Der Spieler – sowie Bad Ems, Bad Nauheim und Bad Pyrmont.
translation: After 1837, the great era of the casinos in Baden-Baden, Bad Homburg, and Wiesbaden began—where Fyodor Mikhailovich Dostoevsky got to know roulette and became addicted to this game, an experience from which the novel The Gambler arose—as well as Bad Ems, Bad Nauheim, and Bad Pyrmont.

src_sentence: Caillois sah 1960 im alea deutliche Anzeichen von Eskapismus: Im Spiel wird künstlich eine Gleichheit der Menschen hergestellt, die in der Realität nicht vorliegt.
translation: In 1960, Caillois saw clear signs of escapism in alea: the game artificially creates an equality among people that does not exist in reality.

translation: The probability of choosing six correct numbers in the "6 out of 49" variant is less than one in ten million—accordingly, the probability of achieving the jackpot with six correct numbers and the correct super number in a single attempt is even just 1 in 139,838,160.

translation: In 1806, Napoleon Bonaparte permitted gambling only in the gaming houses of the Parisian Palais-Royal, where, alongside faro and rouge et noir or trente et quarante, roulette was also played until it was closed by Louis Philippe I at the end of 1837.

translation: However, they had to accumulate a significant portion of the net profit to establish a spa and beautification fund for the participating towns.

translation: Due in part to the danger of addiction, gambling is considered immoral in many societies.

translation: From a qualitative perspective, however, the influence of chance decreases according to the law of large numbers over long sequences of games.

translation: Since gambling is subject to legal restrictions in most countries, the legal definition of gambling is the subject of various legal norms and court rulings that differ from country to country.

translation: Rituals occur that, from the player's perspective, positively influence the probability of winning, or the misconception that there are people with more or less luck.

src_sentence: Das treffende Beispiel ist das Lotto (die Zahlenlotterie).
translation: The fitting example is the lottery (the numbers game).

src_sentence: In der römischen Antike waren Würfelspiele in allen Schichten verbreitet, obwohl die Autoritäten sie mit Strafe bedrohten.
translation: In ancient Rome, dice games were widespread across all classes, even though the authorities threatened them with punishment.

src_sentence: Nicht durch die Klassifikation abgedeckt sind Faktoren der manuellen Geschicklichkeit oder Reaktionsschnelligkeit, die allerdings bei Gesellschaftsspielen – anders als beim sportlichen Spiel – eher die Ausnahme sind, zum Beispiel bei Mikado beziehungsweise Speed.
translation: Not covered by the classification are factors of manual dexterity or reaction speed, which, however, tend to be the exception in parlor games—unlike in sports—for example in pick-up sticks or Speed.

src_sentence: Das normale Glücksspiel kann Ausdruck verschiedener Faktoren sein und aufgrund dieser typologisiert werden.
translation: Normal gambling can be an expression of various factors and typologized on the basis of these.

translation: The dice commonly used today, marked with dots on each side, were presumably invented in Egypt around 2000 BC.

translation: A special feature in the USA is "Indian gambling", which allows Indian tribes to operate casinos on Indian reservations independently of state laws.

src_sentence: Spieler, die unfähig sind, dem Impuls zum Glücksspiel zu widerstehen, auch wenn dies gravierende Folgen im persönlichen, familiären oder beruflichen Umfeld nach sich zieht oder diese zumindest drohen, werden als pathologische Spieler bezeichnet.
translation: Players who are unable to resist the impulse to gamble, even when this entails serious consequences in their personal, family, or professional environment or when these at least threaten, are referred to as pathological gamblers.

translation: Dicing was officially permitted only during the Saturnalia.

translation: 7% of Swiss people use foreign lotteries.

translation: In the territories annexed in 1866, the casinos established there on the basis of contracts with previous governments were permitted to continue until the end of 1872.

src_sentence: Durch die stärkere Reglementierung insbesondere bei Glücksspielautomaten kam es zu einer Umsatzverlagerung hin zu Sportwetten und Online-Casinos bei gleichzeitigem Gewinnrückgang der Spielbanken und klassischen Anbieter.
translation: Due to stricter regulation, particularly regarding slot machines, there was a shift in revenue toward sports betting and online casinos while simultaneously seeing a drop in profits for casinos and traditional operators.

translation: Queen Elizabeth I granted a lottery charter which was drawn in 1569.

src_sentence: L’organisme contrôle aussi les acteurs afin de lutter contre le blanchiment d’argent et le financement du terrorisme.
translation: The body also monitors operators to combat money laundering and the financing of terrorism.

src_sentence: Par exemple, en Belgique, depuis 2011, les jeux d’argent et les paris sont réglementés par des organismes gouvernementaux.
translation: For example, in Belgium, since 2011, gambling and betting have been regulated by government bodies.

src_sentence: Les opérateurs doivent limiter les gratifications financières proposées, informer les joueurs des risques d’un jeu excessif par le biais de messages de mise en garde contre le jeu excessif ou pathologique et faire obstacle à la participation des mineurs, interdits de jeu.
translation: Operators must limit the financial incentives offered, inform players of the risks of excessive gambling through warning messages against excessive or pathological gambling, and prevent the participation of minors, who are barred from gambling.

src_sentence: Il existe ainsi pour les casinos l’article 14 du décret n° 59-1489 du 22 décembre 1959 portant réglementation des jeux dans les casinos des stations balnéaires, thermales et climatiques, ou pour les paris sportifs et les jeux de loterie le décret n° 2007-728 du 7 mai 2007 relatif à l’organisation et à l’exploitation des jeux de pronostics sportifs autorisés par l’article 42 de la Loi de finances pour 1985.
translation: Thus, for casinos there is Article 14 of Decree No. 59-1489 of December 22, 1959, regulating gaming in casinos in seaside, thermal, and climatic resorts, or for sports betting and lottery games, Decree No. 2007-728 of May 7, 2007, relating to the organization and operation of sports prediction games authorized by Article 42 of the Finance Act for 1985.

src_sentence: En parallèle de l’Autorité nationale des jeux, qui est une autorité administrative, il existe d’autres organismes, comme le Service central des courses et jeux (SCCJ) de la Direction centrale de la police judiciaire.
translation: Alongside the National Gambling Authority, which is an administrative authority, there are other bodies, such as the Central Service for Horseracing and Gaming (SCCJ) of the Central Directorate of the Judicial Police.

src_sentence: La fin du XXe siècle a été marquée par une évolution des mentalités à l’égard du jeu et un assouplissement des lois le régissant.
translation: The end of the 20th century was marked by a shift in attitudes towards gambling and a relaxation of the laws governing it.

src_sentence: La législation a évolué pour autoriser les jeux d’argent en ligne, aux fins d’encadrer la pratique, qui se développait en ligne à l’étranger, et avec l’objectif de lutter contre les sites illégaux.
translation: Legislation evolved to authorize online gambling in order to regulate the practice, which was developing online abroad, and with the objective of combating illegal sites.
